page.overview:
Who is Deputy Tony?

Deputy Tony is a minor character who appeared in .

Tony was a deputy from Haddonfield. On October 31, 1989, he, along with the entire police force, was sent to the Myers house. Sheriff Meeker then told his men to head over towards the Haddonfield Children's Clinic, as Jamie Lloyd had felt that her friend, Billy Hill, was in danger.

After Michael Myers was captured by Sam Loomis, they took him to the police station. After they were sure that the nightmare was finally over, Sheriff Meeker had Tony take Jamie back to the clinic. As soon as the two got in the car, they heard a loud explosion. Tony told Jamie to wait in the car while he went to check things out. As soon as he made it inside, he was shot and killed by a machine gun from a man in black.
